fact_check_log.claim: Google Sheets import: open a spreadsheet, File, Import, select the file, Create new spreadsheet (Download section, Google link at claim).
FAQ 'Can I use this template...': same import steps (marker added by edit 11).

Each guest should get the right visa for countries visited or transited and check with the destination's embassy or consulate before travel (Smartraveller link at claim; 'as at November 2026' added by edit 6). No country rules stated; visa appears only as two columns.
Names, addresses, phone numbers and dates of birth count as personal information, and so does sensitive information (OAIC link at claim; email not claimed).
The Privacy Act doesn't cover individuals acting in a personal capacity (OAIC link at claim; no dash).
State or territory laws may still apply in some situations, followed by 'general information as at November 2026, not legal advice'.

Wonderland Studio is our planning app for seating charts and RSVPs; replies, plus-ones and dietary notes arrive in its guest list (/wonderland-studio verbatim in 02-seo studio_guest_list_wording). No CSV, menu, travel-field or cost claims.
Wedded Advisor plans venue, travel, vendors and payments anywhere in the world, as a single point of contact start to finish (brand-facts Claims we can make).

Advisor works in your time zone, quotes in AUD for Australian couples, fee agreed in writing before work begins, inclusions confirmed in writing before you commit (brand-facts; merged to one sentence by edit 12).
Secondary CTA 'puts one Wedded Advisor beside you to plan the whole weekend' (not a brand-facts claim; replaced by edit 10).
